## Host notes: read first

This skill runs in Cursor, Codex or any host that loads `~/.agents/skills`. In Claude Code use the
`/agentic-os` command; it is the same text.

- You run the runtime script `~/.claude/eaos/bin/eaos` in the terminal. The human never does.
- The three subagents the text names (`eaos-builder`, `eaos-reader`, `eaos-checker`) are installed in
  `~/.claude/agents/`, which this host loads too. Spawn them exactly as the text says; each gets its
  own fresh context, and readers may run in parallel.
- Spawn counting, session binding, the scenario-store guard and the pen gate are Claude Code hooks and
  are absent here. Everything else (board, evidence, scenarios, goals, verdict rules, refusals) is
  identical because it lives in the script.
